title: Monthly Energy Bill Estimate
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue (`emporia:circuit`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, and smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=dsmr:telegram
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(import_kwh) as import_kwh, sum(export_kwh) as export_kwh by _time
| eval estimated_bill=round(import_kwh*0.30 - export_kwh*0.10 + 15,2)
| sort - _time
description: Projects your monthly electricity bill from real meter data plus your standing charge, so the bill is never a surprise.
value: A running bill estimate lets you course-correct mid-month rather than opening a shock invoice at the end.
implementation: Ingest meter data and set your tariff and standing charge; schedule daily to keep a live monthly estimate.
visualization: Column chart of estimated monthly bill with a running current-month total.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates your electricity bill as the month goes, so it is never a nasty surprise.
